title: Deepseek makes its 75 percent discount permanent, pricing output tokens at least 34x below GPT-5.5
what_happened: Deepseek is making the 75 percent discount on its top model V4-Pro permanent. At $0.435 per million input tokens, it's at least 11.5 times cheaper than GPT-5.5 and over 34 times cheaper on output.
